record.one_liner: Open-source Postgres development platform with auto-generated REST Data API, Auth, Storage, Realtime and Edge Functions.
record.auth_notes: Data API uses publishable and secret API keys (sb_publishable_ / sb_secret_) on the apikey header. Hosted Supabase MCP uses OAuth dynamic client registration; docs also mention a personal access token (PAT) and OAuth app for manual auth. The dedicated OAuth apps docs page returned Not found, so the third-party OAuth app flow for the Management API is not verified.
record.access_notes: Free plan gives API access with no paid plan or sales contact; free projects are limited to 2 active projects and pause after 1 week of inactivity.
record.api_notes: Data API is PostgREST auto-generated from the database schema at /rest/v1/. Management API and full breadth of other services were not inspected in detail.
